text: Devin can pick up and work Linear/Jira tickets directly
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Devin can implement entirely new features from a request
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Devin can reproduce and fix reported bugs autonomously
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Devin can be run locally via a terminal CLI for quick fixes and interactive coding
quote: Running Devin for Terminal in your local environment for quick fixes, code exploration, and interactive coding right from the command line

text: Longer-running tasks can be handed off from local CLI to cloud-hosted Devin with /handoff
quote: using /handoff to send longer tasks to cloud Devin

text: Devin can be tagged in a Slack or Teams thread to discuss and delegate a bug
quote: Tagging Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you’re discussing with coworkers

text: A task delegated in the web app can be taken over in Devin's IDE mid-progress
quote: Delegating a more complex task via the web application and taking over in Devin’s IDE once it gives you a good first draft.

text: Users can watch Devin's terminal commands execute live and view/copy output logs
quote: Devin’s terminal, where you can watch commands being executed and view output logs. You can also copy the shell output for debugging purposes.

text: Users can jump in to help Devin navigate browsing tasks via an Interactive Browser
quote: You can jump in to help Devin navigate through browsing tasks via the Interactive Browser.

text: A documented Devin API lets developers integrate Devin into apps and automate workflows
quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.

text: Sessions can be created on behalf of any user in an organization via create_as_user_id
quote: you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter

text: Adaptive automatically analyzes prompts and routes each task to the best-suited model
quote: Adaptive analyzes your prompt and routes it to the model that will deliver the best result.

text: Users can override Adaptive and pin a specific model with /model
quote: You can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model.

text: MCP support lets users connect external tool servers (APIs, DBs, issue trackers) to Devin CLI
quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets you connect external tool servers to Devin CLI, giving the agent access to APIs, databases, issue trackers, and any other service you can wrap in an MCP server.

text: MCP tool access is governed by the same permission system as built-in tools, controllable at multiple levels
quote: MCP tools are subject to the same permission system as built-in tools. You can control access at multiple levels

text: Devin CLI exposes each connected MCP tool as its own slash command
quote: Devin CLI exposes each one as a slash command

text: Any Devin session or MCP-compatible client can programmatically create sessions and set up schedules
quote: create sessions, manage playbooks and knowledge, set up schedules, and more

text: Devin can explore and query auto-generated documentation for public or private GitHub repos
quote: These tools let you explore and query documentation for any GitHub repository (public or private with authentication)

text: Scheduling supports cron expressions, recurring/one-time jobs, notification preferences, and agent selection
quote: Supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection

text: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer that can write, run, and test code itself
quote: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer that can write, run and test code.

text: Devin can perform language migrations, e.g. converting JavaScript codebases to TypeScript
quote: Language migrations (e.g. JavaScript to TypeScript)

text: Devin can perform framework upgrades, e.g. Angular 16 to 18
quote: Framework upgrades (e.g. Angular 16 -> 18)

text: Devin offers a conversational UI letting users follow and take over its development process in an embedded IDE
quote: Devin is designed to be a conversational user interface, and allows you to follow and take over Devin’s development process in the embedded IDE.

text: Users can ask context-grounded questions across up to 10 repositories and get AI-powered answers
quote: Ask any question about one or more repositories (up to 10) and get an AI-powered, context-grounded response
